name: Lake Crackenback Resort & Spa (Oaks)
short_description: 4.5-star alpine resort on 150 acres bordering Kosciuszko National Park, with spa, indoor pool and direct access to Skitube.
long_description: Nestled in the Thredbo Valley on the banks of the Thredbo River, Lake Crackenback Resort & Spa offers studio apartments, chalets and lakeview apartments, all fully self-contained with kitchens and private balconies. Guests can unwind at the full-service day spa, indoor heated pool, gym, sauna and on-site restaurant. The resort sits a 15-minute drive from Thredbo and has private driveway access to Bullocks Flat Skitube terminal (0.5km), making it uniquely central to all three major ski fields.

name: Banjo Paterson Inn
short_description: Iconic Jindabyne pub-hotel with 40 rooms, two restaurants, three bars and Kosciuszko Brewhouse on site.
long_description: A true Snowy Mountains institution, the Banjo Paterson Inn sits in the heart of Jindabyne with lakeside views and vibrant pub atmosphere. Rooms range from budget doubles to family loft suites, and guests have immediate access to Clancy's Brasserie, The Overflow burger-and-pizza bar, and the multi-award-winning Kosciuszko Brewhouse. Live music, nightly events and a continental breakfast (boxed, in-room) make this a lively choice for ski groups and families alike.

name: Horizons Lake Jindabyne
short_description: 4-star hotel formerly Rydges Horizons with 120 lake-view apartments, indoor pool, two restaurants and complimentary breakfast.
long_description: Horizons Lake Jindabyne (previously known as Rydges Horizons Snowy Mountains) is Jindabyne's largest full-service hotel, offering 120 individually decorated apartments with full kitchens, washing machines and lake-facing balconies. The property features an indoor heated pool, outdoor tennis court, gym, ski equipment storage, two dining venues (including the premium Embers Fireside Restaurant) and two bars. Free breakfast is included in most room rates, making it great value for ski families.

name: The Station (Snow Stay)
short_description: Budget-friendly Perisher-owned motel and apartment resort 7km from Jindabyne town, with restaurant, bar and shuttle connections.
long_description: The Station is run by Perisher Resort and sits 7km south of Jindabyne town centre on Snowy River Way. It offers no-frills motel rooms and self-contained one and two-bedroom apartments, ideal for budget ski groups. On-site facilities include a restaurant, bar, guest laundry and free parking. Reception is open until midnight (2am Fridays), and Epic Australia Pass holders receive 15% off motel rates.

name: Kosciuszko Chalet Hotel
short_description: Historic ski-in ski-out lodge at Charlotte Pass – Australia's highest resort – with all-inclusive winter packages including meals and lift passes.
long_description: Situated at the heart of Charlotte Pass Village at around 1755m elevation, the Kosciuszko Chalet Hotel is Australia's most remote and highest alpine lodge, accessible only by oversnow transport from Perisher in winter. Winter packages include oversnow transfer, lift passes, daily breakfast and a three-course à la carte dinner, plus complimentary Kids Club running to 9pm. The historic property has a cosy lounge with open fireplace, live music and bar; room types range from classic rooms sleeping up to 6 to luxury suites.
address: Kosciuszko Road, Charlotte Pass, Kosciuszko National Park NSW 2630

name: Lake Jindabyne Hotel
short_description: Lakefront pub-hotel with 40 rooms, popular bistro and sauna, rated #1 hotel in Jindabyne on Tripadvisor.
long_description: Occupying a prime position on McLure Circuit at the water's edge, the Lake Jindabyne Hotel combines affordable motel-style rooms with a well-regarded bistro, sauna, indoor pool, games room and outdoor terrace with sweeping lake views. Rooms are modest but clean, and free breakfast is included. The bistro is famous locally for generous steaks and pub classics, and the outdoor lakeside terrace is a favourite apres-ski spot.

name: Jindy Inn
short_description: Rated #1 B&B/Inn in Jindabyne on Tripadvisor – 14-room boutique motel with lake views, fireside lounge and beauty therapy.
long_description: The Jindy Inn sits on Clyde Street, a short stroll from Jindabyne town centre and within walking distance of cafes, bars and restaurants. All 14 rooms are ensuite and feature either a balcony with lake views or a terrace onto a rose garden. A cosy fireside lounge makes it popular in winter, and the property offers beauty therapy, waxing and facial services. A hot buffet breakfast is served daily, making it ideal for ski-day fuelling.

name: Discovery Holiday Park – Jindabyne
short_description: Lakefront caravan park and cabin resort with BBQ, laundry, bouncing pillow and lake access; 20 min to ski resorts.
long_description: Perched on the shores of Lake Jindabyne, Discovery Parks offers powered and unpowered camping sites alongside modern self-contained cabins ranging from budget to deluxe two-bedroom with fireplace. The park is well-maintained with a kiosk, laundry, bike station, playground and tennis court. Cabins have full kitchens and the lakefront location means you can walk or cycle the foreshore path into town. Pets are allowed seasonally (summer).

name: Aspen Chalets
short_description: Self-contained chalet-style apartments in Jindabyne, popular with families seeking home-away-from-home ski accommodation.
long_description: Aspen Chalets offers a collection of fully self-contained chalet and apartment-style properties in and around Jindabyne, each equipped with full kitchens, lounge areas and parking. Properties vary in size from studio to multi-bedroom configurations, catering to couples and large groups. The chalet aesthetic – with ski storage, mountain décor and proximity to town – makes them a perennial favourite for ski season.

name: Snowy Mountains Resort & Function Centre
short_description: 3-star country hotel in Adaminaby with log fireplace, restaurant, recreation room and proximity to Lake Eucumbene.
long_description: Located in the heritage township of Adaminaby, 45km north of Jindabyne, the Snowy Mountains Resort & Function Centre is a family-run property popular for weddings, functions and ski-season stopovers. Rooms feature memory foam beds, flat-screen TVs and tea/coffee facilities, and the restaurant serves cooked-to-order breakfast. A log fireplace in the guest lounge, billiards table and arcade games round out the facilities. Note: this property is best suited as a base for Charlotte Pass or Selwyn Snowfields rather than Thredbo/Perisher.

name: Kookaburra Lodge
short_description: Best-value lodge in Jindabyne – renovated 12-room property with drying room, free breakfast and walking distance to town.
long_description: Kookaburra Lodge on Clyde Street is consistently rated the best budget accommodation in the Snowy Mountains. The newly renovated property has 12 rooms ranging from motel-style ensuite doubles to dorm-style bunks, with all linen provided. A drying room is a major ski-season asset, and the communal recreation room has tea/coffee facilities, microwave, fridge, TV, lounge and fireplace. Continental breakfast is included, and the town centre is a short stroll away.

name: Chalet Jindabyne
short_description: Family-owned 13-room ski lodge on Gippsland Street with sauna, fireplace, billiards and continental breakfast included.
long_description: Chalet Jindabyne is a local, family-run ski lodge occupying three storeys and 720sqm of mountain living space. Thirteen rooms (10 ensuite, 3 shared bathroom) spread across family and twin configurations, and guests enjoy a sauna, billiards table, large balcony with BBQ, and cosy open fire in the lounge. The continental breakfast is buffet-style, Netflix is available in the TV lounge, and the 2-minute drive to Lake Jindabyne and 30-minute drive to Thredbo or Perisher make it a reliable mid-range ski base.

name: Panorama Jindabyne
short_description: Motel with 25 rooms and sweeping Snowy Mountains and lake panoramas; seasonal restaurant/bar and ski storage on site.
long_description: Panorama Jindabyne sits on Nettin Circuit with unobstructed views over Lake Jindabyne and the surrounding mountain ranges. The 25 air-conditioned rooms span budget to lake-view premium options, and a three-bedroom apartment is available in winter. Breakfast is included during winter. The on-site restaurant and bar operates seasonally, and ski storage is available. Off-street parking and wheelchair-accessible rooms are also offered.

name: Siesta Villa Motel
short_description: 31-room lakeside motel on Jerrara Drive with spa bath, on-site bistro and ski equipment rental, 3km from town centre.
long_description: Siesta Villa is a 3-star motel located on Jerrara Drive with 31 rooms, all featuring balconies and lake views. The property includes a restaurant and bar (Lakeside Bistro & Bar), spa bath, on-site ski rental, and a games room with pool table. Under new management as of recent years, it represents good value for families and couples seeking a quieter lakeside setting away from the main strip.

name: Carinya Village Jindabyne
short_description: Secluded 15-room mountain lodge on 14km-from-slopes lake access with restaurant, conference rooms and traditional architecture.
long_description: Carinya Village is a boutique mountain lodge set on Carinya Lane, offering 15 individually furnished rooms in a tranquil setting. The property includes a restaurant, conference facilities, ski gear storage, guest garden and picnic area. Check-in is from 4pm and limited to guests over 18, making it better suited to couples and corporate groups. Built in 1979, the traditional mountain architecture and garden setting provide a genuine alpine feel.

name: Crackenback Farm Restaurant & Guesthouse
short_description: Award-winning 6-room boutique guesthouse by Glenn Murcutt, 5 min from Jindabyne with acclaimed French country restaurant and ski valley views.
long_description: Designed by Glenn Murcutt and set in the Crackenback Valley five minutes from Jindabyne, this intimate guesthouse has six beautifully appointed rooms, each with a queen bed and private bathroom, with cooked country breakfast included. The French country-farmhouse restaurant has a cathedral ceiling, an open fireplace, and a well-curated wine list – and draws accolades for some of the best food in the Snowy Mountains. Less than 10 minutes from Bullocks Flat Skitube terminal and 20 minutes from Thredbo Village.

name: Alps Lakeview Lodge
short_description: Budget lakeside lodge in East Jindabyne with self-catering rooms, free parking and lake proximity.
long_description: Formerly known as East Lake Travellers Lodge, Alps Lakeview Lodge sits on Jerrara Drive in East Jindabyne within 500m of Lake Jindabyne. The property offers budget-friendly rooms with mini-fridges, microwaves and toaster ovens, making it popular with self-sufficient ski groups. Free WiFi, parking and laundry facilities are available, and the lake foreshore path provides direct access to the main town area without needing to drive.

name: Snow Ski Apartments – Jindabyne
short_description: Self-contained ski apartments in central Jindabyne, offering affordable self-catering accommodation for ski groups.
long_description: Snow Ski Apartments Jindabyne provides a range of self-contained apartments in Jindabyne town, ideal for ski groups who prefer the flexibility of cooking their own meals. Properties typically feature fully equipped kitchens, separate living areas, laundry facilities and ski storage, with the town's supermarkets, restaurants and ski hire shops within walking distance. Booking is managed through the Jindabyne Ski Accommodation platform.

name: Snowy Valley Jindabyne
short_description: Budget shared-room accommodation in Jindabyne, popular with ski groups looking for the lowest-cost base option.
long_description: Snowy Valley Jindabyne offers share-room dormitory-style accommodation for budget-conscious ski travellers. Rooms typically sleep 4–5 people and share bathroom facilities. The property is walking distance to the ski hire and supermarkets in town. Basic but functional for those whose priority is spending their money on the mountain rather than the accommodation.

name: Alpine Country Holidays – Jindabyne Apartments
short_description: Curated portfolio of handpicked self-contained apartments and chalets in Jindabyne and surrounds, bookable through a local boutique agency.
long_description: Alpine Country Holidays is a boutique local accommodation manager offering a handpicked selection of modern apartments, cosy chalets and spacious country homes across Jindabyne, Lake Crackenback and Thredbo surrounds. Properties range from studio apartments to large group homes sleeping 10+, all with full kitchens, lounge areas and high-quality furnishings. Guests report excellent locations within walking distance of Jindabyne's restaurants and bars.

name: Jindabyne & Snowy Mountains Accommodation Centre
short_description: Local agency offering a wide range of self-contained Jindabyne units and homes, plus ski and snowboard rental packages.
long_description: The Jindabyne and Snowy Mountains Accommodation Centre manages a large portfolio of self-contained holiday homes, units and apartments across Jindabyne. The agency's point of difference is bundled ski/snowboard rental packages, allowing groups to book accommodation and gear hire together at a discounted rate. Properties suit couples through to large family groups, and the booking service is available online with phone support.

name: Jindabyne Ski Accommodation – Holiday Rentals
short_description: Online rental platform offering 50+ self-contained ski apartments, townhouses and chalets across Jindabyne and the Snowy Mountains.
long_description: Jindabyne Ski Accommodation is the Snowy Mountains' leading online holiday rental platform, listing over 50 self-contained properties ranging from affordable studio apartments to award-winning luxury chalets. All properties are fully equipped with kitchens and most include ski storage. The platform's high occupancy rates and regular repeat guests reflect consistent quality. Properties are spread across Jindabyne town, Crackenback and Thredbo approaches.

name: Snowy Mountains Airbnb / Holiday Rentals (Jindabyne)
short_description: Wide range of private Airbnb homes and holiday rentals in Jindabyne, from lakefront studios to large group homes with ski storage.
long_description: Jindabyne has a large inventory of privately listed Airbnb and VRBO properties, particularly popular during the July–August ski season when they often represent the best value for groups of 4–10. Options range from lakefront studios to 5-bedroom homes with hot tubs and mountain views. Booking well in advance (3+ months) is essential for peak dates. Many listings include ski storage, drying rooms and are within 5 minutes' drive of Thredbo or Perisher roads.

name: Jindabyne Ski Lodge Accommodation Centre – Private Lodges
short_description: Network of private ski club lodges in Jindabyne available for casual bookings, with drying rooms and communal ski-season facilities.
long_description: Beyond the commercially listed hotels, Jindabyne has a thriving network of private ski club lodges that open casual bookings in peak season. These typically offer bunk or twin rooms in a communal lodge setting with drying rooms, full kitchens, fireplaces and buffet dinners. They cater primarily to ski groups seeking an authentic lodge atmosphere at prices below commercial hotels. Booking is usually via direct contact with individual clubs or through snowaccommodation.com.au.

name: Kosciuszko Brewing Accommodation (Banjo Paterson Complex)
short_description: Self-contained apartment-style rooms in the Banjo Paterson Inn complex, with access to on-site brewery, restaurants and bars.
long_description: The Banjo Paterson Inn complex on Kosciuszko Road includes apartment-style accommodation with loft configurations, lake views and direct access to the Kosciuszko Brewhouse, Clancy's Brasserie and The Overflow. These are among the most social rooms in Jindabyne, favoured by groups who want to walk from bed to bar to slopes without needing a car. Quad loft rooms comfortably sleep 4–6 and include balconies and lake views. The vibrant pub atmosphere means this isn't the quietest option.
